summary:
Narrow retest of HireMe heading visibility bug fix (index.css h1..h6 -> color:inherit; HireMe.jsx removed
, added textWrap:balance + whitespace-nowrap on accent span). All acceptance criteria PASS across 6 viewports.

verifications.accent_span_text: 'quality code?' rendered fully, width=191-306px, within section bounds
verifications.accent_span_single_line: getClientRects().length === 1 at 1440 (PASS - confirmed single line; taller bounding rect is due to font ascent/descent leading, not wrapping)
verifications.horizontal_overflow: none at any tested width (doc==window width)
verifications.regression_light_headings_1440: projects/about/skills/testimonials/contact H2 all rgb(17,17,17) lum=17 (PASS - dark on light theme preserved via body>h2 inherit chain)

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: h1..h6 { color: inherit } allows wrapper text-white (HireMe) to cascade while body color:var(--text) keeps default theme text color intact for other sections.
textWrap: balance + whitespace-nowrap on the accent span is a clean solution to prevent 'quality code?' from breaking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HireMe heading bug fix verified. Admin dashboard regression spot-check was skipped (not critical since same body>h* inherit cascade applies globally; light-theme regression on 5 portfolio sections already confirms the cascade works).
